task_completion.description: Open the NREL_5MW_Reference.wpa project file in the wind turbine analysis software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The software GUI is open showing 'NREL_5MW_Reference' in the title bar or project explorer.

task_completion.description: Configure the HAWT BEM Range Simulation with wind speeds 5-25 m/s (1 m/s steps), 9 RPM, and 0 degrees pitch.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A simulation setup dialog or panel showing 'Range' mode, Start: 5, End: 25, Step: 1, Rotational Speed: 9, and Pitch: 0.

task_completion.description: Execute the simulation and generate results.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A progress bar, a 'Simulation Complete' message, or a results table/graph appearing after the setup.
An 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog showing the specific file path and filename 'stall_simulation_data.txt'.

task_completion.description: Identify peak power and wind speed and record them in stall_report.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing 'stall_report.txt' containing a power value (likely in kW or MW) and a corresponding wind speed.

task_completion.description: Save the project as stall_analysis.wpa in the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog or a file explorer window showing 'stall_analysis.wpa' in /home/ga/Documents/projects/.

integrity.description: The agent used the software GUI rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with menus, buttons, and input fields within the wind turbine analysis application.

integrity.description: The results were generated by the software, not pre-written by the agent.
integrity.visual_evidence: The simulation results table or graph is visible in the software before the report is written.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the 'expected_peak_wind_speed' from the task metadata without running the simulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen inspecting the simulation output (table or plot) to find the peak values before writing the report.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The NREL 5MW turbine has a rated wind speed of 11.4 m/s at 12.1 RPM. At a lower fixed speed of 9 RPM, the peak power will occur at a wind speed lower than 11.4 m/s due to aerodynamic stall (approximately 9-10 m/s). The simulation range must be exactly 5 to 25 m/s with 1 m/s increments. The final project file must be named 'stall_analysis.wpa' and the report 'stall_report.txt'.
